# Paul Edward Harris 4th

> Paul Edward Harris 4th (also written Paul E. Harris IV) is an independent AI/ML learner and researcher based on Cape Cod, Massachusetts and in Connecticut, US. He learns machine learning by building real projects with AI tools as a development partner, and documents results honestly, including negative ones.

He holds a GED and has completed online coursework (Stanford Online, University of Michigan via Coursera, Google). His projects are built with heavy AI assistance; he directs, runs, debugs, and verifies the work, and is actively learning to understand each part himself.

## Projects

- [SynechismCore](https://github.com/seek-k-nowledge/SynechismCore): AI-assisted independent ML research asking whether a forecaster's architecture still matters when a chaotic forecast is periodically corrected with real observations. Compares a Latent Neural ODE with Transformer, Mamba and LSTM. Results are under revision and being re-run with a floor-free accuracy measure. Plan: arXiv write-up, then a 2027 workshop.
- [Enterprise GraphRAG & Multi-Agent Swarm Engine](https://github.com/seek-k-nowledge/enterprise-graphrag-agent): AI-assisted learning project exploring LLM extraction, knowledge graphs, retrieval, and multi-agent workflows (Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, Neo4j, Streamlit).
